answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent identity to a key generated and held inside an attested enclave, with remote verification of its MRENCLAVE. This measurement identifies enclave code and configuration, not a person; hardware-backed key provisioning prevents copying the identity into ordinary virtual machines. An attacker must acquire compatible physical silicon and obtain valid attestation, not merely spawn a meadow of clones. A ferrous server chassis or crystal token alone proves nothing.
